title: Path proximity updates retain unsigned distance staging and signed thresholds
claim: sub_08024DBC is a new 532-byte matching C range. It follows paths in slots 78 through 92, supports an early animation/sound-stop exit, and compares player distances with entities 80,85,90. Unsigned 16-bit distance staging followed by signed 16-bit threshold comparisons preserves the reference conversions. Fifteen separately defined 64-byte EntityPath structs and their typed pointer array replace raw integer pointer loads. Header fields without verified meaning remain unknown. Entity_FollowPath accepts a signed word slot and narrows it explicitly to a byte in its definition; the existing 268-byte function and consolidated callers remain identical. No pins or assembly fallbacks were added.
